svg.aria-label: Vault-OS architecture inside the air gap: clients on the local network, the Vault-OS core, a pluggable inference layer, a TPM-bound encrypted enclave holding PostgreSQL and pgvector, the fail-deadly trust root, and a Rust appliance operating system underneath.
